fields.name: ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg cluster membership tables
fields.description: The tables common.psql creates in the orleans schema for cluster membership.

members.name: orleans_cluster_member_version
members.description: cluster_id varchar(150) primary key; timestamp timestamptz; etag_no integer (the table etag, advanced by every member insert or update); version integer.

members.name: orleans_cluster_member
members.description: cluster_member_id identity primary key; cluster_id references the version row; address bytea, port, generation (unique per cluster); silo_name, host_name varchar(150); status smallint; proxy_port integer; start_time, i_am_alive_time timestamptz; membership_etag_no (the table etag of the write that last changed the row) and membership_version integers.

members.name: orleans_cluster_member_suspicion
members.description: cluster_member_id references the member; address bytea, port, generation of the suspecting silo (primary key with cluster_member_id); timestamp timestamptz of its latest report.
